Schema.Comment: The schema version table stores the current version of the database schema. Implementations are expected to query this table on connecting to the database in order to ensure that the calling code is compatible with the tables in the database.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE schema_version ( version_lock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, version_application_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT schema_version_check_lock_primary PRIMARY KEY (version_lock),
CONSTRAINT schema_version_check_lock_locked CHECK (version_lock = 1) ) STRICT

Schema.Comment: The account_provider_descriptions version table stores account provider descriptions downloaded from the library registry. We store a serialized copy of the description in the apd_data column, but we also extract the title and description into their own columns to allow for the possibility of using sqlite's full text search.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE account_provider_descriptions ( apd_id TEXT NOT NULL, apd_updated_time_last TEXT NOT NULL, apd_title TEXT NOT NULL, apd_description TEXT NOT NULL, apd_data_format TEXT NOT NULL, apd_data BLOB NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT account_provider_descriptions_primary_key PRIMARY KEY (apd_id) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE account_providers ( ap_id TEXT NOT NULL, ap_updated_time_last TEXT NOT NULL, ap_data_format TEXT NOT NULL, ap_data BLOB NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT account_providers_primary_key PRIMARY KEY (ap_id) ) STRICT

Schema.Comment: The account_registry_settings table stores persistent settings used by the account registry.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE account_registry_settings ( ars_setting_name TEXT NOT NULL, ars_setting_type TEXT NOT NULL, ars_setting_value TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT account_registry_settings_primary_key PRIMARY KEY (ars_setting_name) ) STRICT

Schema.Comment:
The time tracking tables store the data of the audiobook time tracking pipeline.
time_tracking_spans stores the raw playback spans reported by the player, pending merging into entries. time_tracking_entries stores the merged entries that have not yet been acknowledged as delivered to the server; a row is deleted only when delivery is confirmed. time_tracking_events is an append-only event log of the operations performed by the pipeline, subject to a bounded retention period.
All times are stored in UTC, rendered with a fixed-width explicit offset (YYYY-MM-ddTHH:MM:SS+00:00), so that lexicographic ordering is equivalent to chronological ordering.
Schema.Statement:
CREATE TABLE time_tracking_spans ( tts_span_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, tts_account_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, tts_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, tts_book_id TEXT NOT NULL, tts_time_started TEXT NOT NULL, tts_time_ended TEXT NOT NULL, tts_time_received TEXT NOT NULL, tts_target_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT time_tracking_spans_primary_key PRIMARY KEY (tts_span_uuid) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE time_tracking_entries ( tte_entry_ulid TEXT NOT NULL, tte_account_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, tte_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, tte_book_id TEXT NOT NULL, tte_target_uri TEXT NOT NULL, tte_during_minute TEXT NOT NULL, tte_seconds_played INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT time_tracking_entries_primary_key PRIMARY KEY (tte_entry_ulid),
CONSTRAINT time_tracking_entries_check_seconds CHECK (tte_seconds_played >= 0 AND tte_seconds_played <= 60) ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE time_tracking_events ( ttev_sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ttev_time TEXT NOT NULL, ttev_operation TEXT NOT NULL, ttev_library_id TEXT NOT NULL, ttev_book_id TEXT NOT NULL, ttev_entry_ulid TEXT, ttev_during_minute TEXT, ttev_seconds_played INTEGER, ttev_exception TEXT ) STRICT
